_comment: What the Licences page (Settings, About) lists, beyond the Godot engine's own notices (Engine.get_license_text and friends, added at runtime). One entry per third-party item that ships in an export. covers: the names THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md uses for the item (tests/unit/test_third_party_licences.gd keeps the two in step). paths: the addon folders it stands for. text: the notice inline, or text_path: a file that ships in the export (export_presets.cfg include_filter). not_shipped: addons the export filter leaves out, so the page does not list them.

entries.name: Steamworks redistributable
entries.what: Valve's steam_api64.dll (and the steam_api libraries for the other platforms) in the Steam builds.
entries.text:
The Steamworks redistributable (steam_api64.dll on Windows, with the matching steam_api libraries on macOS and Linux) belongs to Valve. It is used under Valve's Steamworks terms, is not covered by this game's licence, and keeps Valve's own signature.

Steamworks is available at https://partner.steamgames.com/
